version.approval_notes: Self-distributed Linux desktop extension. Requires the one-shot native Python helper; install instructions and complete helper sources are in the attached source archive. See docs/AMO_REVIEW.md for build instructions, local-only fixture tests and data flow. No credentials or user state are bundled. First-party JS is unminified; third-party libraries are byte-for-byte official releases: DOMjudge 9.0.1 (https://github.com/DOMjudge/domjudge/tree/9.0.1), Bootstrap 5.3.7 (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.7), Font Awesome Free 6.5.2 (https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/tree/6.5.2). Font binaries come from the official DOMjudge 9.0.1 image at digest sha256:e9704bdae8e08440eb0042c9817116dc9767a511f577e9318c4f0710ad5b5727. Per-file hashes, origin paths and licenses are in extension/assets/UPSTREAM.json and docs/UI_UPSTREAM.md. The localhost host permissions support isolated HTTP fixture regression tests. Do not initiate a real QOJ virtual contest or submit code on a real account for testing.
